encoder_view.B/S: DINOv2 patch 14, smaller edge 448 -> the image is scaled with its aspect ratio preserved, so BTAD-03 gives a 32x42 patch grid over a 448x588 canvas
encoder_view.C: AnomalyCLIP image_size 518 -> the image is squashed to a square 518x518, giving a 37x37 grid in normalised coordinates; it is bilinearly re-gridded onto B's 32x42 grid at scoring time (aspect ratio is lost, the normalised coordinates are not)

mask_fix: ground-truth masks are resized with INTER_NEAREST to grid*14 = 448x588 so that each patch owns an exact 14x14 mask block
